dct_description_sm:
This dataset contains all the unsurveyed Yukon First Nations Interim Protected Lands. Interim Protected Lands are lands withdrawn from disposal by Orders in Council (OIC) under the Lands Act and Territorial Lands (Yukon) Act to facilitate the settlement of Yukon First Nation claim in the Yukon.

Distributed from [GeoYukon](https://yukon.ca/geoyukon) by the [Government of Yukon](https://yukon.ca/maps). Discover more digital map data and interactive maps from Yukon's digital map data collection.

For more information: [geomatics.help@yukon.ca](mailto:geomatics.help@yukon.ca)
